mintAuthority.summary: DOLA's 48-hour Timelock operator can mint durable supply to any recipient without a posted-collateral check or numeric token cap. FiRM and the enabled PSM Fed have governance-raiseable issuance ceilings; the flash minter must repay and burn principal within one transaction. Frontier expands into its fixed cToken with borrowing paused; chair-only unbounded chosen-recipient extraction is not established. Inverse confirms that no dedicated recurring whole-supply-to-backing reconciliation or independent sign-off exists. Its response identifies the decisive escrow and delegate as founder Nour Haridy's personal position and wallets, corroborated in part by its public founder-address disclosure. This corrects the escrow-specific voting-provenance rationale but leaves founder-affiliated unilateral voting control. Complete execution certificates and a typed authority graph are still absent. Frontier minter revocation is planned with no date and was not executed at the reviewed pin. Ethereum DOLA bytecode immutability does not make operator/minter membership or downstream administration immutable.

mintIncidents.summary: The April 2022 Anchor lending-market oracle-manipulation exploit inflated INV collateral value, enabling DOLA borrowing and withdrawal from Anchor pools and leaving bad debt. It was not a demonstrated DOLA minter-key compromise or bypass of token mint authorization.

controls.label: DOLA token operator (Timelock, 48h delay)
controls.capDescription: The token has no hard mint cap. The operator can mint directly and authorize additional minters through its 48-hour Timelock; operational Fed issuance is a separate authorized path.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095807, DOLA.operator() returned 0x926df14a23be491164dcf93f4c468a50ef659d5b, whose admin() returned 0xbeccb6bb0aa4ab551966a7e4b97cec74bb359bf6 and delay() returned 172800 seconds. The issuer deployment source permits mint() from either the operator or an address whose minters mapping is true; burn() is permissionless for the caller's own balance. The token constructor assigned the initial operator to its deployer; the current operator address follows later role transfers, not a separate minter grant. At Ethereum block 26296822, operator() remains the Timelock and minters(operator) is false; mint() independently admits the operator.

controls.label: FiRM Fed authorized DOLA minter
controls.capDescription: Global supplyCeiling() is 100000000000000000000000000000 raw units (1e29), or 100 billion DOLA. Proposal 332 deprecated the restrictive global ceiling by setting this high value; the source still checks it and per-market ceilings. Expansion is chair-only into registered, non-borrow-paused markets within their ceilings. Only gov can change global and per-market ceilings, so the Timelock can raise them while the chair cannot.

controls.label: Frontier Fed authorized DOLA minter
controls.capDescription: Frontier expansion has no local numeric supply ceiling: the chair raw-mints DOLA into a fixed cToken and the Fed receives matching shares. Borrowing is paused, while cToken minting is not. Only the Timelock admin can unpause borrowing or reduce reserves. Outside shareholders can redeem finite existing claims; contraction burns principal and takeProfit pays only the fixed gov recipient. These facts do not establish chair-only unbounded chosen-recipient extraction or a collateral cap.

Verified Fed.sol expansion has no local ceiling and deposits only into the fixed cToken, receiving matching shares; it exposes no cToken share-transfer or arbitrary-call function. In a counterfactual sequential simulation based on block 26214783, chair expansion(1e30) succeeded, an existing shareholder redeemed only its finite claim, chair borrowing reverted borrow is paused, and contraction(1e30) burned the principal. This is simulated execution, not a mined transaction or exhaustive closure certificate. Verified Comptroller _setBorrowPaused permits only admin to unpause; cToken _reduceReservesFresh is admin-only and pays admin. takeProfit is permissionless but source-fixes its recipient to gov, not a chair-chosen address. controls.label: PSM Fed authorized DOLA minter
controls.capDescription: The enabled PSM Fed has a 10 million DOLA supplyCap, raiseable only by governance, and chair-only expansion into its immutable PSM. At the fresh pin it had supplied 200,000 idle DOLA to that PSM, which held no USDS. This is capped issuance inventory, not funded holder-redemption capacity; the issuer-documented other Fed generation is not an enabled minter.

controls.label: DOLA atomic flash minter
controls.capDescription: maxFlashLimit() is 5000000000000000000000000 (5 million DOLA), and owner-only setMaxFlashLimit can raise it. The source retrieves and burns the minted amount before returning; this is atomic flash issuance, not durable unbacked supply.
controls.evidence: An Alchemy full-history AddMinter/RemoveMinter query through Ethereum block 26095807 returned 54 logs and 29 distinct candidates. Pinned native minters(address) checks identify this flash minter plus the three Feds as the four enabled minters. owner() is the operator Timelock, dola() is the native DOLA token, flashMinted() is zero and maxFlashLoan(DOLA) equals the 5 million DOLA limit. Verified source requires repayment and burns the flash-issued DOLA in the same transaction. Proposal 213's DOLA.addMinter payload authorizes this flash minter; its limit setter and atomic repayment/burn remain separate reviewed properties.

review.evidence: Historical review at Ethereum block 26097135 (2026-10-01T11:21:35Z) enumerated 54 AddMinter/RemoveMinter events and 29 candidates, confirming four enabled minters. operator() was 0x926df14a23be491164dcf93f4c468a50ef659d5b with delay() 172800 seconds; a read-only mint(operator,1e18) call as operator succeeded without collateral or a numeric token cap. Frontier chair expansion(1e18) deposited minted DOLA into its fixed cToken. FiRM's ceiling was 1e29 raw, PSM's cap 1e25 raw and flash maxFlashLimit 5e24 raw, with governance setters and mandatory atomic flash repayment/burn. The historical 2026-10-03 sweep at Ethereum block 26113566 (2026-10-03T18:20:11Z; hash 0x8ee5bf8702023bb24470045b03b62f22fe10f1c46654ea9e79377e5dac7193b9) confirmed Frontier's enabled mapping, Timelock gov, 2-of-6 chair Safe and uncapped fixed-cToken expansion, but did not certify complete Fed/chair/cToken/Comptroller execution reach. Fresh review at Ethereum block 26214783 (2026-10-17T20:51:59Z; hash 0xd8de05d65dd285a6482739aeee16a7ee5a9a492fb9d8a0f0edf784957f94caee) confirmed the same native minter census and operator. Source-reviewed mint(to,amount) and a read-only operator mint to a chosen outside recipient for 1e30 raw establish aggregate unbounded economics independently of Frontier; impersonating the authorized operator does not bypass its governance or delay. Frontier borrowing was paused at both the historical sweep and fresh pin; the Fed holds matching shares for fixed-market expansions, contraction burns principal, outside suppliers redeem finite claims and takeProfit pays fixed gov. Chair-only unbounded chosen-recipient extraction is not established, so the prior non-token-governor Safe/G1 accusation is withdrawn rather than replaced by a collateral-cap claim. Governance-process rungs remain denied because complete execution certificates and a typed authority graph are absent AND D32 positively fails: at block 26214783, independently verified at Ethereum block 26214981 (2026-10-17T21:31:47Z; hash 0x694cea66e87f898336b470261d904d40e4386b0abfd6895c39f67180a100119f), INVEscrow 0x53039ef2274f9bb4852632ecb48c6dd9ebf5edf5 has beneficiary Safe 0x495886947eace9788360f46be55c758f92ecd074, a separate 2-of-3 controller, while xINV.delegates(escrow) is EOA 0x3fcb35a1cbfb6007f9bc638d388958bc4550cb28, not one of its owners. Its 6412508715301415641032 raw xINV at exchangeRateCurrent 7829257361229428580 supplies approximately 50,205.18 INV-equivalent votes, exceeding quorumVotes() of 24,000. Inverse's 28 October 2026 response, with ownership confirmed as of 20 October, identifies the escrow, its beneficiary Safe, all three Safe-owner EOAs and the delegate EOA as founder Nour Haridy's personal position and wallets; the public inverse-web transparency source pages/transparency/dao.tsx at commit f6228d3a33d9515529f707eb03d9ea52010de246 independently lists the escrow, the delegate and beneficiary-Safe owner 0x16ec2aea80863c1fb4e13440778d0c9967fc51cb as FounderAddresses, while personal key ownership of Safe owners #2/#3 remains issuer confirmation. At Ethereum block 26296822 (2026-10-29T07:12:23Z), getCurrentVotes(delegate) was 6412866053323290480490 raw xINV at exchangeRateStored 7829257361229428580, approximately 50,207.98 INV-equivalent votes of which approximately 50,205.18 derive from the escrow, against quorumVotes() of 24,000 and 489,561.32 INV-equivalent total votes; the public delegates API separately reported 50207.97877265418 at its own snapshot block 26296849 (2026-10-29T07:18:27Z) with ten delegators. GovernorMills passes only with forVotes > againstVotes and forVotes >= quorum, so this is quorum-sufficient affirmative power for an otherwise unopposed proposal, not an unconditional majority; the Safe's 2-of-3 threshold governs its own actions, not votes cast by the delegated EOA, and the issuer states the delegation is intended to remain. The identified escrow route fails D32 as voting-affiliated-unilateral under rule 1's positively-identified issuer/team-affiliate exception, replacing the prior other-holder/unknown-beneficial-ownership rationale; the finding is identification-based, not inferred from zero direct balances or concentration alone. The approximately 2.7977 INV-equivalent outside-escrow residual is an upper bound on third-party delegated power that also includes the delegate's self-delegation and the founder's publicly labeled Safe-owner EOA and is distributed across seven other listed delegators; it remains a possible rule-2 other-holder casting route subject to its own review. Fed-chair Safe owner 0x962228a90eac69238c7d1f216d80037e61ea9255 separately holds 24,531.56 delegate votes, above quorum, with unpublished affiliation, recorded as an unresolved-identity concentration diagnostic rather than a positively identified affiliate route. GovernorMills guardian() is the separate cancel contract 0x941c2699ec7e55a50bde030d8e1e70649839259d (deployer-authorized allowCancel, RWG-executed executeCancel), governance-cancel context rather than a voting route. The founder attribution provides no complete voting-power conservation, execution certificates or typed authority graph and does not qualify a favorable governance topology. Inverse's 28 October 2026 response confirms, effective 20 October, that no dedicated recurring reconciliation of total native DOLA supply against backing is run and no separate reconciliation owner, report cadence or independent sign-off exists. Transparency APIs, Fed counters, market debt, alerts and events are ongoing accounting inputs; they do not establish recurring external whole-liability reconciliation covering operator-direct issuance and bad debt. Reconciliation is therefore recorded as none. No continuous/periodic reconciliation or prudential/financial-attestation supervision credit is claimed. Ethereum DOLA bytecode immutability does not make operator/minter membership or downstream administration immutable. Aggregate economics and derived-consistent fallback remain unbounded and unbounded-adverse; the retained lending-oracle incident is historical and resolved, not an active minter compromise.
